Package com.example.syntaxio.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.example.syntaxio.model.User
public class User extends Object
Represents an application user and their account-level progress summary.

The user model stores identity and authentication data alongside summary counters used by profile and dashboard views, such as total hints used, completed challenges, login count, and current activity streak.

  • Constructor Details

    • User

      public User(String username, String passwordHash)
      Creates a new user before it has been assigned a database id.

      Account timestamps are initialized to the current time and progress counters are initialized to zero.

      Parameters:
      username - unique username for sign-in
      passwordHash - hashed password value

    • User

      public User(int id, String username, String passwordHash, LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime lastLoginAt, int totalHintsUsed, int totalChallengesCompleted)
      Creates a user loaded from storage with core progress counters.

      This overload uses lastLoginAt as the update timestamp, sets login count to zero, and initializes the current activity streak to zero.

      Parameters:
      id - database identifier for the user
      username - unique username for sign-in
      passwordHash - hashed password value
      createdAt - time the account was created
      lastLoginAt - time the user last logged in
      totalHintsUsed - total number of hints used by the user
      totalChallengesCompleted - total number of challenges completed by the user

    • User
